name: Blur Finance
rootCause: Yield aggregator Blur Finance withdrew more than $600,000 in assets from BNB Chain and Polygon before deleting websites and social media accounts. The project, which has only been active for about a month, has amassed about 750 users on its initial BNB Chain implementation, which was announced on Polygon on August 5.

descriptions.text: Yield aggregator Blur Finance withdrew more than $600,000 in assets from BNB Chain and Polygon before deleting websites and social media accounts. The project, which has only been active for about a month, has amassed about 750 users on its initial BNB Chain implementation, which was announced on Polygon on August 5.

Blur Finance was reported to have exited with about $600,000 in user funds on BNB Chain and Polygon on 2022-08-10. The public record supports a rug pull classification, but it does not include a verified drain transaction or recovery path. The available evidence supports an operator exit scam, classified as a rug pull. Blur Finance's social channels and website disappeared at the same time funds were reported missing, and no contract bug has been established from the available public evidence.
